Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A triangle has side lengths 5 cm, 7 cm, and 8 cm. What type of triangle is it based on its sides? : Scalene-triangle Isosceles-triangle Equilateral-triangle
Hints: Check if any sides are the same length.
Solution: Scalene-triangle.  A triangle with no equal sides is called a scalene triangle.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. All three sides of a triangle are 5 cm long. What type of triangle is this? : Scalene-triangle Isosceles-triangle Equilateral-triangle
Hints: Think about a triangle where all sides are the same.
Solution: Equilateral-triangle. An equilateral triangle has three equal sides.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A triangle has angle measures 40°, 65°, and 75°. What type of triangle is this based on its angles? : Acute-triangle Right-triangle Obtuse-triangle
Solution: Acute-triangle. All angles are less than 90°, so the triangle is acute.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A triangle has angles 30°, 60°, and 90°. Name the triangle based on its angles : Acute-triangle Right-triangle Obtuse-triangle
Solution: Right-triangle. One angle is 90°, so the triangle is a right triangle.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A triangle has two sides that are equal in length. What type of triangle is it based on its sides? : Scalene-triangle Isosceles-triangle Equilateral-triangle
Hints: Think about a triangle with at least 2 equal sides
Solution: Isosceles-triangle. An isosceles triangle has at least two sides equal.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A triangle has angles 100°, 40°, and 40°. What type of triangle is it based on angles? : Acute-triangle Right-triangle Obtuse-triangle
Solution: Obtuse-triangle.  One angle is greater than 90°, so the triangle is obtuse.

Question Choices: A triangle is equilateral. Is it acute, right, or obtuse?
Hints: What is the angle size in an equilateral triangle?
Solution: Acute|acute. Each angle is 60°, which is less than 90°. So all equilateral triangles are acute.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A triangle has angles 40°, 50°, and 90°. What type of triangle is it based on its sides? : Scalene-triangle Isosceles-triangle Equilateral-triangle
Hints: Different angles mean different side lengths
Solution: Scalene-triangle. Different angles mean different side lengths. All three angles are different, so the triangle is scalene.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. Two angles of a triangle are 60° and 60°. What type of triangle is this? : Scalene-triangle Isosceles-triangle Equilateral-triangle
Hints: The total angles of a triangle is always 180˚. Equal angles have equal opposite sides.
Solution: Equilateral-triangle. The total angles of a triangle is always 180˚. The third angle is also 60˚. If all angles are equal, all sides are equal.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A triangle has angles 50°, 50°, and 80°. Classify it by sides and angles : Scalene-acute-triangle Scalene-right-triangle Isosceles-acute-triangle Isosceles-Obtuse-triangle
Hints: Look for equal angles and compare to 90°.
Solution: Isosceles-acute-triangle. Two angles are equal -> isosceles. All angles are less than 90° -> acute
